about:
BCI's Sioux Falls division operates from a facility at 4501 North 2nd Avenue in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The division traces its roots to 1975 when it was established as a leader in custom corrugated packaging across the upper Midwest and Central Plains. Buckeye Corrugated (BCI) acquired the operation in 2013, and it is now led by General Manager Chad Sabers alongside a management team that includes Area Vice President Adam Williams, Region Sales Manager Nic Poshusta, Controller Mary Jo Galles, and Creative and Client Services Manager Vladimir Sobolev.

The division manufactures a broad range of corrugated packaging solutions, from standard boxes to complex multi-printed packages featuring unique cuts, folds, and joints. Capabilities include multi-color printing, die cutting, scoring, and structural design for point-of-purchase displays. The team emphasizes rapid turnaround, describing its timeframe as unparalleled, though specific lead times or production volumes are not published.

Customers span food and beverage, automotive aftermarket, and consumer packaged goods. Public case studies reference work for Gallo Family Vineyards on a Meals on Wheels display, Alpura for dairy product launches, and Royal Purple for off-shelf retail programs. The division also supports retail execution with end-cap and POP display assembly services.

The company's stated differentiators center on a culture of continuous improvement—captured in the mantra "outwork yesterday"—and a commitment to domestic production summed up by the tagline "Built for Performance. Made in America. Delivered Coast-to-Coast." The focus is on making the customer experience transformational rather than merely transactional.
